signUpDescription: Create your access and connect with what matters.
otpDescription: We sent you a 6-digit code. Use it to continue.
mfaDescription: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
recoveryDescription: Use one of the recovery codes you saved.
pendingDescription: Your email is verified. An administrator will review your access request.
pendingNotice: We will email you when your access is approved.
passwordlessHint: No passwords. Just you and your email.
trustHint: If your account uses two-step verification, you can skip that step in this browser. We will always verify your email.
resendHint: If your email is authorized, you will receive a code valid for 5 minutes.
securityNote: Your access protected, every step of the way.
artDescription: Simple access to everything you can create.
helpDescription: This space has restricted access. If you do not have access yet or need help signing in, contact your application administrator.
reauthProfile: Confirm your identity to continue to My profile. We will ask for a new email code and, if needed, your second factor.
reauthSecurity: Confirm your identity to continue to Security. We will ask for a new email code and, if needed, your second factor.
errorUnavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Please try again shortly or contact your administrator.
errorVerifyAgain: Verify your email again to continue.
errorDenied: We could not authorize your access. Contact your administrator.
errorAccessNotEnabled: We could not find an enabled account with this email. Check the address or request access from your administrator.
errorInvalidCode: The code is invalid or has expired. Please try again.
errorTooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errorCaptchaExpired: The security verification expired. Please try again.
errorRegistrationClosed: Registration is closed. Contact your administrator.
errorRegistrationFailed: We could not complete registration. Contact your administrator.
errorRegistrationChanged: Registration settings changed. Please try again.
errorPermission: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errorUnknown: We could not complete the operation. Please try again.
errorNetwork: We could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
deniedDescription: Contact your administrator to review your account permissions.
notFoundHeading: This place does not exist yet.
notFoundDescription: Return to your space to keep creating.
mailBody: Your access code is {code}. It expires in 5 minutes. If you did not request this code, ignore this email.
mailChangeBody: The code to confirm your new email is {code}. It expires in 5 minutes. If you did not request this code, ignore this email.
